name: pharmacological intervention
description: Drug-discovery and pharmacology angle: a chemical entity, the gene or protein it targets, its mechanism of action, and its clinical use -- not the hereditary cause of the disease (genetic determinants) nor the patient-level course of care (clinical mechanisms). Entity branches of the pharmacological stratum at priority 1 (chemical entity, gene, protein, macromolecular complex, disease or phenotypic feature, clinical entity, biological process or activity); predicate weights derived from the Biolink hierarchy (biomedcat.weights).
reading_focus: gene: druggable target and the protein it expresses; protein: binding site and mechanism of action of the compound; disease: indication, contraindication and adverse effect; biological process: pathway modulated by the treatment, not its hereditary or clinical-course context
